headline: Paraguayan Senate Rejects Peña's Request for Impeachment Defense Time
summary: The Paraguayan Senate rejected President Santiago Peña's request for 72 additional hours to prepare his defense against impeachment by a vote of 42 to 3, following his announcement of resignation amid a political and financial crisis linked to Ueno Bank.
why: Presidential resignations and impeachment proceedings trigger severe political instability, threatening sovereign credit ratings and investor confidence in national markets.

impacts.name: Paraguay
impacts.why: Political instability and impeachment proceedings increase sovereign risk and economic uncertainty.
